name: Licence and rights governance register for adopted third-party artifacts
description: BP-SEC-05 (card 65). Defining mechanism: VERBATIM RIDER PRESERVATION plus block-on-absence. Every other adoption review summarises a licence; this one asserts byte-identity between the rider text in the source LICENSE file and the rider text in the register, because the estate already carries a non-standard rider (MIT plus a clause forbidding ML training and eval folding) that is destroyed the moment it is flattened to the word 'MIT'. Two hard outcomes follow: an artifact with no discoverable licence may not be adopted, and an ambiguous licence DEFERS to the owner rather than defaulting to permissive.

artifacts.description: Fan-out keys - one reviewer per third-party artifact (skill, plugin, MCP, dataset, model)

intended_use.description: What the estate actually DOES with the artifact. A rider is only checkable against a declared use.

register_path.description: The append-only register every adoption decision is recorded in

block_on_absent_license.description: When true an artifact with no discoverable licence cannot be adopted. Never defaults to permissive.

license-locator.description: Finds the licence text for one artifact and records ABSENT as a finding rather than as a blank field

obligation-extractor.description: Extracts riders and obligations VERBATIM - attribution, share-alike, no-ML-training, field-of-use

owner.description: The human owner - the only actor who may resolve an ambiguous licence or accept an obligation

body.title: Locate the licence text; ABSENT is a finding, not a blank

work_unit.title: Locate and hash the licence text for one third-party artifact
work_unit.question_or_target: Find the licence document for the fan-out artifact (LICENSE, COPYING, an SPDX header, or package metadata), record its path and sha256, and where none exists record license_state ABSENT with the paths that were searched - so absence is a measured result rather than an empty field.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: the licence file path, its sha256, and the enumerated list of paths searched when the state is ABSENT
tests_required: an artifact with no LICENSE anywhere must record ABSENT with a non-empty searched-paths list
an SPDX-header-only artifact must be located, not reported ABSENT (the format-coverage control)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the obligation extractor reads the located file itself, not this unit's description of it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6501 when a licence path plus sha256 exists, or ABSENT plus the searched paths; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6501 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to package metadata; never resolve to a default licence

work_unit.title: Extract every rider and obligation as a verbatim span of the licence bytes
work_unit.question_or_target: For the located licence, emit the base SPDX identifier plus every rider and obligation as a VERBATIM span - the exact substring of the source bytes with its start and end offsets - so the register can assert byte-identity instead of trusting a paraphrase.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: distinguishing a rider from boilerplate is judgement; preserving it is mechanical

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each rider carries its byte offsets into the source licence file plus the sha256 of that file, so byte-identity is re-checkable without the extractor
tests_required: an MIT licence carrying an extra no-ML-training clause must be recorded as MIT PLUS the verbatim rider, never flattened to MIT
a rider whose recorded span does not match the source bytes at the recorded offsets must fail extraction
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: byte-identity is re-verified from the source file and the offsets, independently of the extractor
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6502 when every recorded rider re-reads byte-identically from the source at its offsets; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6502 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on an offset mismatch - it is an extraction bug

body.title: Check each obligation against what the estate actually does

stages.title: A summarised rider is a lost obligation
No licence means not adoptable - never defaulted to permissive
An ambiguous licence DEFERS to the owner; it never resolves itself
stages.prompt: These artifacts have a licence that cannot be resolved against the declared intended use. For each, decide: adopt with the obligation recorded, adopt with the conflicting use dropped, or do not adopt. This workflow will not assume a permissive reading.

stages.title: Pin an exact ref per artifact and append to the register

work_unit.title: Pin every adopted artifact to an exact ref and append its rights record to the register
work_unit.question_or_target: For each adoptable artifact record an exact immutable ref (commit sha, release tag plus digest, or dataset revision) alongside its verbatim obligations, and append one row to the register; an unpinned third-party dependency is itself recorded as a supply-chain finding rather than as a pinned row.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the register is the durable governance record

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one register row per artifact with the pinned ref, the base licence id, the verbatim obligations and the compatibility verdict against each declared intended use
tests_required: an artifact with a floating ref (a branch name) must be recorded as a supply-chain finding, not as pinned
the register row count must equal the adoptable artifact count (no silent drop)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner reads the register before any of these artifacts is used for a declared purpose
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6503 when every adoptable artifact has a register row with a pinned ref and verbatim obligations; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6503 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on a floating ref - it is a finding, not a transient

stages.title: Every registered artifact carries an immutable ref

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the artifacts; writes only under command-center/governance/**

derived_from.license: MIT plus an OpenAI/Anthropic rider forbidding ML training and eval folding

mechanism_fingerprint.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-SEC-03 contains the EXECUTION risk of entering a third-party checkout. This measures LEGAL obligation, and its unique assertion is byte-identity of a rider span - a check no other blueprint in this set performs.

x_extensions.not_legal_advice: The register records obligations and their source spans. It does not interpret enforceability, and an ambiguous licence always defers to the owner.

worked_example.name: the agent-mail rider must survive the register
worked_example.narrative: mcp_agent_mail resolves to MIT plus a verbatim rider forbidding ML training and eval folding; because eval-folding is a DECLARED intended use, compatible_with_intended_use is false and the artifact reaches the owner ruling rather than the register - exactly the outcome flattening the rider to 'MIT' would have hidden. trailofbits-skills resolves to CC-BY-SA-4.0 with a verbatim attribution and share-alike obligation, compatible with internal-tooling, pinned to a commit sha. context-mode-clone has no LICENSE at any searched path, so license_state is ABSENT with the searched-paths list, and block_on_absent_license stops it being adopted rather than defaulting it to permissive.
